text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 479 units of esomeprazole sodium at 26.2 units per day, providing 18 days on hand. Corvale General holds 1,045 units at 38.3 units per day, providing 27 days on hand. Stock detail: Corvale East has 132 units of 20 mg/5 mL (16.4 days) and 311 units of 40 mg/5 mL (32.7 days). Corvale General has 242.16 units (25.6 days) and 308.43 units (31.6 days). Omeprazole capsules are also on hand at both sites.

Why (FDA record): Esomeprazole sodium is not listed on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) received an Official Action Indicated classification on 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08. Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026-07-16 were classified Voluntary Action Indicated. Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) shows only VAI inspections through 2024-07-25. Hainan Poly Pharm. Co., Ltd. (FEI 3005115952) shows only VAI inspections through 2023-06-30.

Our position: Current inventory covers 18 to 32 days depending on site and strength. No FDA shortage listing exists. The labeled manufacturing sites have recent VAI inspection histories.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Eugia US LLC and confirm supply reliability; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand weekly; requires pharmacy director approval.
3. Buyer to verify Eugia US LLC labeling and manufacturing site information before committing; requires quality assurance approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
